text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—So yeah, the cake is already in the 
fridge. All that's left is to hurry up and 
decorate the venue...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aight, I'll help out too. What else is 
there~...
choice_data_list: ...? What's everyone doing?
...? What's everyone doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait, it's you...!
choice_data_list: ……？みんな、何してるんだ？
……？みんな、何してるの？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't scare me like that~. Ah geez... 
we're setting up a surprise for Pokke.
choice_data_list: For Jungle Pocket?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah, y'know? She's been working 
crazy hard lately. So it's like a "good 
job" or "congrats~" kinda thing.
choice_data_list: ジャングルポケットに？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she had been performing 
brilliantly lately. Her presence was truly 
that of a "leading star of the new 
era"...! I had been deeply moved by her as 
well.
choice_data_list: I want to show her my appreciation too!
I want to show her my appreciation too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Guess I'll make you our errand 
runner~. Go sneak off and get it, it's a 
secret from Pokk—
choice_data_list: 俺も……彼女を労いたいな！
私も……彼女を労いたいな！
choice_data_list_en: I want to... show her some appreciation too!
I'd like to show her some appreciation too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, what're you guys up to~?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ack! Pokke-san?! Uhhhhh, well, nothing 
really...? It's totally nothing~~! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah...? What's with you guys. Oi, what were 
you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, it's that thing, y'know! Uhh, what 
was it again, Trainer-san~?
choice_data_list: Eh?! Uh, a new training theory—!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
All right, now's our chance...! We'll go 
ahead with prep, we'll leave the rest to 
you!
choice_data_list: えっ！？えっと、新しい運動理論が――！
choice_data_list_en: Huh!? Um, a new exercise theory—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —So like... wanna go hang out for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh~? No, what is going on? Where'd 
those guys go?
choice_data_list:
More importantly, let's grab some good 
food...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, Pokke, you can have a bite, 'kay? 
Say "aah".
choice_data_list: それより、おいしいものでも……！
choice_data_list_en: More importantly, how about something tasty...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Sweet~~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! If you know something, spill 
it—!
choice_data_list: I-I wonder? Oh look, an arcade!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Isn't that cute? Want anything? I'll 
win it for ya!
choice_data_list: さ、さぁ？あっ、ゲーセンあるよ！
choice_data_list_en: B-Beats me? Oh, look, an arcade!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't want it...
choice_data_list: Then how about air hockey?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ain't doing it............ Hmph...
choice_data_list: じゃあ、エアホッケーとかは？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~... My bad... But like... it's not 
what you think...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
............I get it, alright. I know it 
ain't anything bad.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, it pisses me off when you hide 
stuff! So...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take me somewhere way more fun! Or else 
I'm heading back to the academy.
choice_data_list: だから……？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...! *snicker*... Hahahaha. What are you, 
a kid?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, you're a kid too! Ahhh damn it, I 
want something fizzy to drink.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright alright, Trainer-san will go buy 
it for ya. Hehe... no seriously, for real 
though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even though she acts like this, in a race 
she's "like that". She's pretty amazing, 
huh...
choice_data_list: I know, right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few hours later, the three of us headed 
to the party venue. A whole crowd of 
Jungle Pocket's underlings and friends had 
gathered there...!
choice_data_list: わかる……！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Surpriiiise!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations on your amazing run!
Congratulations on your amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You guys...!
choice_data_list: 君の大活躍に祝福を！
貴方の大活躍に祝福を！

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, so that's what this was?! 
Ahahahaha! Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, keeping it under wraps was such a 
pain. Well then, to "Today's Main Star☆", 
once again...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Good job. And congrats. No joke... you 
really are the "Strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Heheheh! Damn straight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket's mood did a complete 
turnaround as she rejoiced. In her 
innocent eyes, a fathomless, intense light 
burned brightly.
